updates.summary: P2 introduces traditional British biscuits, likening Jaffa Cakes to cheesecake, which prompts P1 to question the mention of cheese and start an animated debate over whether the packaging is orange or yellow.
After concluding their debate over the packaging color, P1 inspects and smells a Jaffa Cake, comparing it to an Oreo before taking a bite and admitting with pleasant surprise that it is not nasty.
P1 finishes evaluating the Jaffa Cake with a 7/10 rating before Toby introduces Rich Tea biscuits, which P1 incredulously derides as a cracker.
P1 argues that the Rich Tea biscuit is merely a cracker before rating it 'regular out of 10', after which P2 introduces Party Rings and shows P1 how people traditionally eat them off their fingers.

P1 samples the Party Ring biscuit from his finger, enthusiastically calling it 'fire' and rating it 9/10 as the best one yet, while repeatedly calling it a cracker, prompting P2's playful exasperation.
P1 concludes his evaluation of the Party Rings biscuit, giving it a strong 9/10 score and praising it as the best snack, with P2 agreeing warmly.
